description: This file defines the 'Attribute' model class for the OpenCart admin catalog module, providing methods to manage attribute groups and attributes in the database, including create, read, update, delete, and listing functions.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents the attribute management model in the admin catalog module, providing CRUD operations for attribute groups and attributes.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Creates a new attribute group in the database, including its descriptions and associated attributes.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Modifies an existing attribute group and its descriptions, attributes.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Deletes an attribute group and its related descriptions and attributes.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute group by ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Lists attribute groups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute groups, possibly filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for a given attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all attribute descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a specific attribute group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute group descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute within an attribute group, including descriptions.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Deletes an attribute and its descriptions.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute by ID, including its description.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Lists attributes with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Returns total count of attributes, filtered by optional criteria.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Returns total number of attributes within a specific attribute group.

methods.name: addAttributeDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific attribute.

methods.name: deleteAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes attribute descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getAttributeDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute's description in a particular language.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for an attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute descriptions for a specific language.
